description: This file defines the AndroidPackageConverter class, which implements conversion and reference creation logic for Android package names within an IDE or plugin environment, including handling package references and refactoring support.

classes.name: AndroidPackageConverter
classes.description: A converter class for Android package names, providing string conversion and reference creation, including nested classes for reference sets and references.

classes.name: MyPackageReferenceSet
classes.description: A custom reference set for package references, handling special cases based on the Android project configuration.

classes.name: MyPsiPackageReference
classes.description: A custom PSI package reference class that supports resolving, renaming, and binding to package elements, with special handling for package movement and refactoring.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a string from its serialized form to the internal representation (identity function).

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the internal package name to its string form (identity function).

methods.name: createReferences
methods.description: Creates PSI references for a given DOM value representing a package name.

methods.name: createReference
methods.description: Creates a package reference, with special handling if the Android project overrides the manifest package.

methods.name: multiResolve
methods.description: Resolves the package reference to its target element(s).

methods.name: isReferenceTo
methods.description: Checks if the reference points to a specific PSI element.

methods.name: handleElementRename
methods.description: Handles renaming of the referenced package element.

methods.name: bindToElement
methods.description: Binds the reference to a new package element, updating related manifest attributes if necessary.
